speaker: hired_men
text: The Theatre door. Eightpence, as was said.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Eightpence. Into his hand. There.

speaker: (the carter)
text: A heavy hamper for eightpence. Michaelmas, if the hill is kinder.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Michaelmas is the host's word, not the fare. Off.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Will. Is this stage truly twice the breadth of the inn's?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have not paced it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Then a man might stand in the wrong half all morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He stands where the book puts him. I have not measured it, and I will not give thee a number I have not walked.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then don't look.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: At the yard?

speaker: john_heminges
text: At the yard. We are at the door. The inn will not grow by being stared at.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Chest under the stage. Two locks. I turn both before anyone goes looking for a drink Lent does not allow.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The nine lines are still foul paper at the lodging. They are not in that chest.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Then they are not my copy yet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Kemp will say I have pinned him, when I do copy them. It is the ink he objects to. Ink pins a man to Tuesday's joke on Thursday.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Leave them foul until you mean them. I will not copy a joke twice.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wednesday. A fair hand. I have not cut any of them yet.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Keep it cold up there. The house is shut till Easter. Don't sing it, Nick.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I was not going to sing.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The galleries give a song back, and there is no one here to pay them.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Is there a loft here as knowing as the inn's?

speaker: john_heminges
text: There is no loft full of ostlers. There is a stage, and it is dark. Thou art not playing on it today.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three baskets, and the hamper. That is the whole of the winter house. The books are not in the count.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The books stay with me. Come under, out of the wind.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am behind you. I have still not paced it.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Then I will not look back either.
